heading.html: What Is a Korean Body Scrub?

children.text: A Korean body scrub, or seshin, is a traditional exfoliation treatment performed in Korean bathhouses. Using textured mitts, the skin is vigorously scrubbed after a steam or soak to remove dead skin cells and reveal smooth, rejuvenated skin. Known for its thoroughness, this treatment improves circulation and allows for better absorption of moisturizing products. At King Spa, we offer an authentic full body scrub experience that leaves your skin glowing.

children.text: Begin with a 15-30 minute hot tub soak in our gender-segregated bathhouse to open pores and soften skin. Nudity is required, as is customary in Korean body scrubs, to ensure thorough exfoliation across the body.
Using traditional Korean exfoliating mitts, your therapist will vigorously scrub away dead skin cells. The full-body exfoliation removes impurities, leaving your skin silky smooth and rejuvenated.
After the full body exfoliation, you will be rinsed off with warm water. You can then shower off and enjoy the rest of your spa day!

children.html:
What is a Korean body scrub?

A Korean body scrub (seshin) is an exfoliating treatment that removes dead skin cells using textured mitts after a hot steam or soak. It leaves skin smoother, improves circulation, and enhances product absorption.

Is the Korean body scrub suitable for sensitive skin?

No, A Korean body scrub isn’t ideal for all skin types. If your skin is sensitive, you should avoid the treatment unless approved by your therapist.

Do I have to be nude for a Korean body scrub?

Yes, nudity is required during the treatment, as is traditional in Korean spas. This allows for a thorough exfoliation and the best results.

How often should I get a Korean body scrub?

 Every 4 to 6 weeks is ideal for maintaining smooth, healthy skin. Frequency depends on skin type and personal preference.

Can a body scrub remove dark spots?

 Exfoliation helps fade dark spots by promoting cell renewal. Learn more in our blog: Can Body Scrub Remove Dark Spots?.

Is a Korean body scrub painful?

 It can feel intense but is not usually painful. The pressure can be adjusted for comfort.

How should I prepare for a Korean body scrub?

Hydrate well, avoid shaving or waxing 24 hours before, and soak in hot water for at least 15 minutes before the treatment.

What should I do after a Korean body scrub?

Moisturize well, avoid harsh skincare products, and stay hydrated to keep your skin soft and glowing.

Do you wash hair during a Korean Body Scrub?

Yes, hair washing is included as part of the Korean body scrub treatment.

How much does a body scrub cost at King Spa?

Please see our pricing page for current treatment pricing information

How do I book a body scrub at King Spa?

All of our spa treatments, including our body scrubs, must be booked in-person at King Spa. You can easily book your body scrub treatment in the locker room with our friendly staff.
